flags.name: Flag 1 - CF Dashboard
flags.description: From the Event Search view, set your time range 3 to 72 hours and clear your search 2. The SDL Search Helper makes it easy to quickly create queries, providing autocomplete and search for operators, functions, and fields. Clear your search 2, then type dataSource into the search bar. You will see a list of fields that include this term. Click dataSource.vendor to add the field to your query. The Search Helper will then show a list of vendors that are producing logs in the console. The flag is the approximate number of logs originating from Cloudflare.

flags.name: Flag 2 - CF Dashboard
flags.description:
<s1-nav>From the <s1-label>Event Search</s1-label> view, set your <s1-label>time range</s1-label> <s1-number><mark class="number">3</mark></s1-number> to <s1-value>72 hours</s1-value> and clear your <s1-label>search</s1-label> <s1-number><mark class="number">2</mark></s1-number>. 

Type <s1-value>dataSource</s1-value> into the search bar. You will see a list of <s1-label>fields</s1-label> that include this term. Click <s1-value>dataSource.vendor</s1-value> to add the field to your query.</s1-nav>

The Search Helper will then show a list of <s1-label>comparison</s1-label> operators. Choose the = operator, then select <s1-value>Cloudflare</s1-value> from the list.

Type <s1-value>src</s1-value> into the field bar. You will see a list of <s1-label>fields</s1-label> that include this term. Click <s1-value>src_endpoint.ip</s1-value> to add the field to your query.
 
Use the <s1-label>Fields</s1-label> <s1-number><mark class="number">4</mark></s1-number> list to see the top source ip addresses.</s1-flag-body>

<s1-flag example="165.225.10.87">The flag is the source ip address with the most amount of Connections. </s1-flag>
